mapping_rules.person: person:<existing shared ID>; a visual node is not required.
mapping_rules.strand: Preserve the (entry_id, strand_id) compound address; map to a concept only after a scope review.
mapping_rules.candidate: A discovery candidate is not automatically a field or accepted concept.
mapping_rules.entry: atlas_entry, distinct from the concept(s) it presents.
mapping_rules.citation: Claim.evidence points to a source record; preserve check_status, locator, checked_on, support_assessment and limitation without elevating scope.
mapping_rules.history: Preserve existing proposal history; production supersession/withdrawal remains a contract design gap.
